about.title: ABOUT ME
about.description: Hello! I'm Deivid Julian Alvarado Moran, a Software Engineering student passionate about web development and creative design. I enjoy building projects that combine technology with innovative ideas, applying different tools and programming languages.

timeline.title: TIMELINE
timeline.helpText: Explore my story: each frame is a moment. Use
timeline.photo1Desc: This photo is very special to me because it was my first day of school ever. I remember feeling nervous because I didn’t know what to expect.
timeline.photo2Desc: In this photo I remember we had to perform a play, and I was upset because they gave me the role of the jester. I really disliked having to play that character.
timeline.photo3Desc: This last photo was taken just a few years ago, on my 17th birthday. It was a special moment because after a long time, both my mom’s and dad’s sides of the family were reunited.
